coveragePolicy.reason: The existing approved corpus cannot reach the 10-source-kernel research gate in these two domains because the prior public shards contain only seven music kernels and six UX kernels. The four-domain corpus gate remains unchanged.

groups.title: Music Structure and Expression Evidence Lab
groups.courseBrief: Music Structure and Expression Evidence Lab, a four-session course in which students distinguish texture, expressive markings, phrase closure, and changes of tonic through source-grounded listening and notation decisions.
groups.qualityFocus: Stress near-neighbor distinctions: texture versus instrumentation count, dynamics versus tempo, a local pause versus cadential closure, and tonicization versus sustained modulation. Require explanations to rule out the strongest plausible alternative without inventing unheard musical evidence.

groups.title: UX Service Evidence and Progress Lab
groups.courseBrief: UX Service Evidence and Progress Lab, a four-session course in which students connect service operations to user experience, write contextual scenarios, plan observational tests, and communicate multi-stage progress accessibly.
groups.qualityFocus: Stress evidence boundaries and method selection: separate a service blueprint from a journey map, a user scenario from a feature walkthrough, observation from moderator coaching, and a true linear step indicator from decorative status color. Make each misconception concrete and correctable.

claimBoundary: This targeted campaign closes measured source-kernel gaps in music theory and UX. It does not weaken the unchanged four-domain training gate, supply preference labels, or prove an adapter win.
